name: FlowDrop
description: FlowDrop is a visual workflow editor component built with Svelte 5 and xyflow/svelte for embedding drag-and-drop flow builders into your own applications. You control the backend and infrastructure end to end: workflows run on your own servers with your own data and security rules, with no vendor lock-in or data leaving your systems.
